title: OpenAI reports AI chip-design gains, up to 14% AMD GPU PPA
summary: OpenAI says its models helped design its Jalapeño inference chip and optimize AMD flagship GPU IP, reducing vector-unit standard-cell area by about 13% and matrix-unit area by about 10% in the former, and improving power, performance, and area by up to 14% over a highly optimized baseline in the latter. Some AMD changes have entered manufacturing design, and OpenAI says the Jalapeño optimizations were validated during chip bring-up. OpenAI also announced a partnership with Synopsys to train a GPT-Synopsys model. The figures are self-reported, with no independent verification or methodological detail in the supplied item.
